scientific_integrity: All-arity claims have constructive two-pebble proofs. Finite enumeration supplies corroboration only. No independent scientific review or certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only ordinary FO2, one interpreted equivalence relation, equality and r unary predicates; no counting quantifiers, constants or other relations. Older differently phrased colored-equivalence classifications may exist. Finite checker samples do not replace proof of all-cardinality equivalence.
title: Complete two-variable theories of colored equivalence relations and sharp induced cores
